sources.citation: RAVEL authored scalar conventions; license: Apache-2.0. Located authored declarations do not substitute for primary scientific references.

nodes.statement: Declare the scalar framework, parameter basis, truncation, total-width assumptions, supplied mass reference and source release. Framework labels do not establish applicability.
nodes.applicability: Apply only to a supplied source, parameterization, likelihood and declared validity domain; no qualification is implied.

evidence.locator: RAVEL authored conv:higgs; RAVEL authored scalar convention; analytic rate scaling and explicitly supplied framework, basis, likelihood and uncertainty definitions. Primary source acquisition remains a run-time obligation.

nodes.statement: Declare whether each loop modifier is resolved from elementary couplings or independently effective. Rates scale as production modifier squared times partial-width modifier squared divided by total-width scaling; supplied extra partial widths enter that denominator.
